tools.name: keep_list_accounts
tools.description: Lista as contas Google Keep vinculadas a este install (id/email, label). Use pra descobrir o `account` quando há várias.

tools.name: keep_find
tools.description: Busca notas no Google Keep. Filtros opcionais: query (título/texto), labels, colors, pinned, archived, trashed (default false).

tools.name: keep_get_note
tools.description:
Retorna uma nota (ou lista) do Google Keep pelo id.

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_create_note
tools.description: Cria uma nota de texto no Google Keep. Recebe a label 'keep-mcp' automaticamente pra poder ser gerida depois.

tools.name: keep_create_list
tools.description: Cria uma checklist no Google Keep. `items` = array de { text, checked }. Recebe a label 'keep-mcp' automaticamente.

tools.name: keep_update_note
tools.description:
Atualiza título e/ou texto de uma nota. Pra listas, edite os itens com os tools de list item.

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_pin_note
tools.description:
Fixa ou desafixa uma nota (`pinned`, default true).

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_archive_note
tools.description:
Arquiva ou desarquiva uma nota (`archived`, default true).

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_set_note_color
tools.description:
Define a cor de uma nota. Uma de: DEFAULT, RED, ORANGE, YELLOW, GREEN, TEAL, BLUE, CERULEAN, PURPLE, PINK, BROWN, GRAY.

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_trash_note
tools.description:
Move uma nota pra lixeira.

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_restore_note
tools.description:
Restaura uma nota da lixeira.

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_delete_note
tools.description:
Apaga uma nota permanentemente (não dá pra desfazer).

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_add_list_item
tools.description:
Adiciona um item a uma checklist.

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_update_list_item
tools.description:
Atualiza texto e/ou estado (checked) de um item de checklist (por item_id).

Bulk support: accepts item_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_delete_list_item
tools.description:
Remove um item de checklist por item_id.

Bulk support: accepts item_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_list_labels
tools.description: Lista todas as labels da conta.

tools.name: keep_create_label
tools.description: Cria uma nova label.

tools.name: keep_delete_label
tools.description: Apaga uma label pelo nome.

tools.name: keep_add_label_to_note
tools.description:
Anexa uma label (por nome, criada se não existir) a uma nota.

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_remove_label_from_note
tools.description:
Remove uma label (por nome) de uma nota.

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_list_note_collaborators
tools.description:
Lista os colaboradores (emails) com quem a nota é compartilhada.

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_add_note_collaborator
tools.description:
Compartilha uma nota com um colaborador (por email).

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_remove_note_collaborator
tools.description:
Remove um colaborador (por email) de uma nota.

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: keep_list_note_media
tools.description:
Lista os blobs de mídia (imagens/áudio/desenhos) de uma nota, com links.

Bulk support: accepts note_ids for batched execution.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_keep" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: keep_list_accounts, keep_list_note_collaborators · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: keep_list_accounts, keep_add_note_collaborator, keep_remove_note_collaborator, report_bug · Destructive: keep_delete_note, keep_delete_list_item, keep_delete_label, keep_remove_label_from_note, keep_remove_note_collaborator, marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: keep_list_accounts, keep_list_note_collaborators · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: keep_list_accounts, keep_add_note_collaborator, keep_remove_note_collaborator, report_bug · Destructive: keep_delete_note, keep_delete_list_item, keep_delete_label, keep_remove_label_from_note, keep_remove_note_collaborator, marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
